function.name: read_file

function.description: List files and directories in the workspace.

path.description: Directory path relative to workspace root

function.description: Search file contents for text or regex. Pass path to restrict the search to a workspace file or directory; omit it to search the workspace.

query.description: Text or pattern to find in file contents, not a filename

path.description: Optional workspace-relative file or directory to search

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file in the workspace. Overwrites existing file.

path.description: Path to file relative to workspace root

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Surgically edit a file by replacing oldText with newText. Read the target with read_file first and pass the hash from its [hash:…] trailer as expectedHash; stale or unseen state is rejected instead of overwriting it.

path.description: Path to file relative to workspace root

expectedHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the file as last observed — copy the [hash:…] trailer from the read_file reply

function.name: run_command
function.description: Execute a command with sanitized environment in the native host shell. Set environment to wsl only when an available WSL distribution is explicitly selected.

cwd.description: Optional working directory relative to workspace root

environment.description: Execution environment (default windows). 'wsl' runs the command via the default or named WSL distribution.

wslDistro.description: WSL distribution name when environment is 'wsl' (default: the system default distro)

function.description: Search indexed repository intelligence for relevant files, symbols, and tests.

function.description: Search structurally indexed symbols and definitions in repository intelligence.

function.name: repo_references
function.description: Find definitions and classified references for a symbol.

function.name: repo_dependencies
function.description: Find imports and package dependencies of a file.

function.name: repo_dependents
function.description: Find indexed files that depend on a file.

function.name: repo_tests
function.description: Find tests related to an implementation file with confidence reasons.

function.name: repo_impact
function.description: Advisory impact candidates and blast radius for changed paths. Does not grant execution or verification authority.

function.name: repo_file_summary
function.description: Structured summary of an indexed file: symbols, exports, imports, language, size.

function.name: repo_callees
function.description: Static call candidates inside one indexed file with edge provenance and preserved ambiguity.

function.name: repo_callers
function.description: Candidate callers of a symbol by name or id, with edge provenance and preserved ambiguity.

function.description: Build a fresh, deduplicated context pack within a token budget.

function.description: Return repository intelligence index status and health.

function.description: Create a durable git checkpoint for recovery before significant modifications.
